Rectangular incense stand, Huanghuali wood and burl wood Late Ming (1573–1644)

Description

The top of standard mitre, mortise, and tenon construction with a flush, tongue-and-grooved, single-board, huamu floating panel supported by two dovetailed transverse braces.

The clay, ramie, and lacquer undercoating is almost completely intact.

Exhibited

  • Hong Kong, 1990 – 1991, Hong Kong Museum of Art

Literature

Grace Wu Bruce, Hong Kong, 1991, pp. 98 – 99

Estimate: 4,800,000 - 4,800,000 HKD
